verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS shared-inbox product like Missive, but the evidence pack never documents any way to choose a storage region. The 'IP restrictions / Secure access by location' feature controls where users can sign in from, not where data is stored. It is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
